content.title: Update webapp-server-ports.expertise.md to new port values
content.description:
Per library-architect's accepted review (comment mqibd3i1rm on mqiax8p1ib), this file lives under your expertise folder (.agentic/expertise/webapp-validator/) which is outside the architect's domain, so it routes to you.

Task: verify and update .agentic/expertise/webapp-validator/webapp-server-ports.expertise.md so every documented port value aligns with the new standard (source of truth = closed task mqh2hwulrt):
- dev API -> 3001
- dev Vite -> 3000
- E2E API -> 5001
- E2E Vite -> 5000

No remaining 5173/5174/3000-as-API references should remain. This task is independent of the specs/roadmap update and runs in parallel.

content.content:
Done. The expertise file `.agentic/expertise/webapp-validator/webapp-server-ports.expertise.md` already reflects the new port standard everywhere it documents current values:

- Dev: backend API 3001, frontend Vite 3000, proxy → 3001
- E2E: backend 5001, frontend 5000 (strictPort), baseURL http://localhost:5000
- Invariants preserved: E2E ports differ from dev ports; `reuseExistingServer` stays absent; port-5000/AirPlay constraint documented as environment-side.

Verification: re-read the file and grepped for stale values (5173, 5174, 3000-as-API). The only matches are intentional historical references in the Timeline section and the parenthetical 'was X before the 2026-06-16 port change' notes — these record the migration history and should remain. Re-checked the sources of truth (`server/index.ts`, `frontend/vite.config.ts`, `playwright.config.ts`) and every current port value matches.

No edits were needed — the file was already updated during the original 2026-06-16 port-change work (recorded in its own Timeline entry).
